# Public fixtures

Shapes and unit semantics derive from an authenticated read-only P40 REST 2.5.0
audit. Identifiers, network address, energy counters, session IDs, dates and
durations are synthetic; they do not identify the reference device or its usage.
No real username, password, token, certificate fingerprint or raw audit is included.
Control responses are mocked from documented response contracts, not field-tested.
